title.hr: Asimetričan put kroz NAT i vatrozid
title.en: Asymmetric path through NAT and firewall

concept.hr: Odgovor vraćen drugim putem uređaj sa stanjem ne prepoznaje
concept.en: Replies taking another path break stateful devices

summary.hr: Zahtjev izlazi kroz Izlaz 1 i ondje se zapiše veza. Odgovor se vrati kroz Izlaz 2, koji ga ne prepoznaje, pa pada, iako ga je poslužitelj poslao.
summary.en: The request leaves through exit 1, which records the connection. The reply returns through exit 2, which does not know it, and is dropped though it was sent.
